methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected directly from each vendor's official pricing page on 2026-06-14 via live WebFetch. Every USD figure appears on the fetched page. Quote-only and contact-sales tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd = null — no figures were guessed. Telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null on every plan because this is a non-telephony vertical. For GitHub Actions, compute per-minute rates were cross-checked against the official billing documentation. Travis CI pricing was confirmed from the /pricing/ path after /plans/ returned 404. Semaphore redirected from semaphoreci.com to semaphore.io; pricing fetched from the canonical domain. Harness CI has no publicly listed prices and is included with null plans. Drone.io returned 404 and was excluded. corroboration URLs are second independent sources confirming figures where available.
